\section{Introduction}

We present a novel framework for evidence-gated machine learning in pathology.
Our approach combines foundation models with claim-level ledger validation.

\section{Methods}

We developed a system that integrates deep learning models with
structured evidence tracking. The pipeline processes histopathology
slides and produces interpretable predictions with full traceability.

\section{Results}

The system demonstrates improved performance compared to baseline
approaches. We validated the framework on multiple experimental settings
and confirmed the stability of our results across different conditions.

\section{Conclusion}

This work establishes a foundation for more rigorous validation
practices in machine learning for medical imaging.
